testcase.system-out: Scenario: Toggle an origin plane while the active view is locked ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user copies the Primary view representation as BrowserView and activates BrowserView ✔ And The MCAD Software has an empty part with a copied view active ✔ And the YZ origin plane is hidden ✔ When the user chooses Lock from the active view context menu ✔ Then the active view displays a lock indicator ✔ When the user chooses Visibility from the YZ origin plane context menu ✔ Then the YZ origin plane is visible ✔ And Visibility is checked in the plane context menu ✔ And the active view still displays a lock indicator ✔ When the user chooses Visibility from the YZ origin plane context menu again ✔ Then the YZ origin plane is hidden ✔ When the user chooses Lock from the active view context menu again ✔ Then the active view no longer displays a lock indicator
